WITH rating_film_counts AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT f.film_id) AS film_count
  FROM inventory i
  JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
avg_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(film_count) AS overall_avg
  FROM rating_film_counts
)
SELECT SUM(rfc.film_count) AS total_films_above_avg,
       AVG(rfc.film_count - ac.overall_avg) AS avg_excess
FROM rating_film_counts rfc
CROSS JOIN avg_count ac
WHERE rfc.film_count > ac.overall_avg
